program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?))
    (define (hmirror cells)
      (let* ((n (norm cells)) (cmax (apply max (map second n))))
        (norm (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- cmax (second p)))) n))))
    (define (vmirror cells)
      (let* ((n (norm cells)) (rmax (apply max (map first n))))
        (norm (map (lambda (p) (list (- rmax (first p)) (second p))) n))))
    (define template (norm (find-color g 4)))
    (foldl (lambda (anchor out)
             (let* ((color (at g (first anchor) (second anchor)))
                    (shape (cond [(= color 1) template] [(= color 2) (hmirror template)] [else (vmirror template)]))
                    (placed (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first anchor) (first p)) (+ (second anchor) (second p)))) shape)))
               (paint-cells out placed 4)))
           (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
           (filter (lambda (p) (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p)))) (or (= v 1) (= v 2) (= v 3)))) (grid-positions g)))))
